title: Hearty Buttery Portuguese Spaghetti Pasta
description: A rich and satisfying vegetarian dish featuring spaghetti, kombu cold extract, and a blend of buttery flavors, perfect for a solo dinner.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the spaghetti according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium heat and saute the garlic and onion until softened.
Add the kombu cold extract to the skillet and stir to combine.
Add the shredded cheese to the skillet and stir until melted and gooey.
Drain the cooked spaghetti and add it to the skillet, tossing to combine with the cheese sauce.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste.
Serve hot, topped with additional butter if desired.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro if desired.
